label: Split Flap Board
blurb: The frame is a mechanical departure board. Every tile is split across the middle and the top half drops forward on its hinge, clatters through a run of flickering intermediate flaps and lands showing the new shot, the whole board rattling through column by column. The dropping flap catches light on its face, throws a shadow onto the half beneath it, and there is a hard dark seam across the middle of every tile. Set the board size, how many flaps clatter past, and how heavy the seam and the shadow are.
